snippet.title: NARON – Playtest Trailer | Co-op Mining Roguelite (1–4 Players)
snippet.description:
47 crews went down. None reached the core. Now it's your turn.
Request access to the NARON playtest on Steam – it runs 10–18 October 2026

NARON is a co-op mining roguelite for 1–4 players. You take a drillship twenty depths down into a dying moon. Every depth has an objective waiting, and the drill won't move until it's done. Between depths the crew votes on the route at the map table – two depths of foresight, one direction: down. The rock is fully deformable, every bit of progress wakes the moon, and if the crew falls, the run is over.

The shortest description: Deep Rock Galactic meets the route map from Slay the Spire.

Playtest: 10–18 October 2026 · Windows PC via Steam · online co-op and solo

▶ WHAT YOU'RE GETTING INTO
• Online co-op for 1–4 players, fully playable solo
• Twenty depths of fully deformable cave terrain, generated fresh every run
• Branching route tree with crew voting and 20+ hazard modifiers
• Ten main objectives, eighteen side contracts and three boss fights
• Six biomes: rock caverns, mushroom caves, flooded chambers, lava halls, ice fields and crystal caves
• Survival pressure from oxygen, toxic gas, stamina and travelling pressure fronts
• Fourteen resources, onboard crafting and gear salvaged from lost crews' camps
• Proximity voice chat, radio channel, pings, sprays and emotes
• Permanent progression tree with 28 upgrades – the next run starts deeper in knowledge, not deeper in the rock
• Session saves: pause a run and continue later
• Text in English, German, French and Spanish, Mission Control voice-over in English and German
• Full gamepad support, plays on Steam Deck

NARON is not a horror game. It gets tight and stressful, but the moon isn't trying to scare anyone – it's collapsing, and the crew happens to be standing in it.

▶ ROADMAP
Playtest: 10–18 October 2026 (Steam)
Public demo: Steam Next Fest, February 2027
Release: 2027, Windows PC on Steam

NARON is made by TIDERAFT, a one-person game studio in Hamburg. Also from TIDERAFT: Rift Miner, out now on Steam
